summary: Verified GRN failure-screenshot feature end-to-end. Backend (all 3 endpoints) + non-blocking asyncio.to_thread fix are CORRECT and working. However, a UI gap was found: the 'View Failure Screenshot' button is NOT rendered inside the Confirmed GRNs row-click detail dialog (only inside the Lookup->pending-shipment card), so from the Confirmed GRNs tab (where a failed GRN actually lives) the button is unreachable. Direct backend endpoint serves the PNG correctly (200 image/png).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'View exact SAP screen at time of failure' button (data-testid='grn-view-failure-screenshot-button') is only rendered inside the shipment-lookup card at line ~702 (guarded by `shipment.status === 'approved' && !busy` on the LOOKUP-loaded shipment). It is NOT rendered inside the Confirmed GRNs row-click dialog (`grn-confirmed-detail-dialog`), which is the ONLY UI path that surfaces a failed sync for an already-approved shipment. Result: on Confirmed GRNs tab, opening a Sync-Failed row shows the Sync Failed badge + Retry button but no way to view the SAP failure screenshot at all. Reproduced with the pre-seeded ZTESTSCR1 (sap_sync_status=failed, screenshot_path populated). Also Lookup input has maxLength=6 so 9-char doc codes cannot be looked up as a workaround.

action_items: Add the failure-screenshot button/link inside the `grn-confirmed-detail-dialog` block (GrnApprovalPage.jsx ~line 928) using the same condition: `confirmedDetail.sap_sync_status !== 'posted' && confirmedDetail.sap_gr_result?.per_po?.some((p) => p.screenshot_path)` -> onClick sets screenshotModal. Without this, the whole failure-screenshot feature is unreachable via the Confirmed GRNs tab in production.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_playwright_supplier_pgr_service.py:61 - `await asyncio.to_thread(object_storage_client.upload_failure_screenshot, png, po_number)` correctly offloads the blocking `requests.put` in object_storage_client.py off the event loop. Return shape preserved (screenshot_path key). Non-blocking fix is CORRECT.
server.py:7526 - `GET /admin/grn/failure-screenshot` correctly validates prefix `sap-mrp/grn_failures/` (400 on invalid) and uses asyncio.to_thread for the blocking get_object. Good.

GrnApprovalPage.jsx - the failure-screenshot button lives only in the pending-lookup shipment card and is duplicated-in-spirit but missing from the Confirmed GRNs detail dialog. Refactor to a shared subcomponent so both flows show it consistently.

rca of the issue: The screenshot-viewing feature was built into the pending-shipment/Lookup path only. When user later shifted the sync-failed state into the Confirmed GRNs tab detail dialog (a separate dialog that reads from `confirmedDetail` state, not the `shipment` state), no one added the parallel button there. So the whole feature is functionally dead from the tab where users will actually see failed syncs. Mitigation: add ~10 lines of JSX inside `grn-confirmed-detail-dialog` mirroring lines 702-716.
